sources.title: Gaia DR3 source field definitions
sources.used_for: parallax/error in mas, proper-motion components in mas/year, magnitudes and BP-RP. Authoritative archive schema, not a frozen source catalogue.

sources.title: Bailer-Jones 2015, Estimating distances from parallaxes, v2
sources.used_for: Positive reciprocal parallax is a naive calculation. No noisy-parallax inference, prior or uncertainty qualification is provided by arithmetic checks.

sources.title: IAU 2015 Resolution B3, arXiv v1
sources.used_for: Nominal equatorial Earth radius 6378100 m and solar radius 695700000 m are exact conversion constants, not measured sizes with zero uncertainty.

sources.title: JPL Solar System Dynamics, Astrodynamic Parameters
sources.used_for: Astronomical unit is 149597870700 m, IAU 2012 Resolution B1.

sources.title: NASA/NSSDC Earth Fact Sheet
sources.used_for: Volumetric mean radius 6371.000 km and mass 5.9722e24 kg used only for definition sensitivity. Listed density is 5513 kg/m^3; legacy 5.514 g/cm^3 is not claimed to match current physical precision.

sources.title: NASA Exoplanet Archive composite-parameter calculation notes
sources.used_for: Spherical density 3M/(4piR^3). Composite values can combine references and need not be jointly physically consistent. Derived fields do not establish joint-fit covariance.

sources.title: Winn, Transits and Occultations, arXiv v5
sources.used_for: Circular random-orientation probability including grazing events uses (Rstar+Rp)/a. Area-ratio depth omits limb darkening, dilution and grazing geometry. This paper does not calibrate the product heuristic or its illustrative trapezoid.

sources.title: Gaia DR3 datamodel, source catalogue
sources.used_for: Search-indexed official documentation supports total proper-motion norm of pmra and pmdec. Direct full-page retrieval returned 503 during this review; R01 supplied accessible field definitions.
